target_customer: Creative and media teams such as agencies, production and e-commerce content teams
problem: Media teams juggle several tools for ingest, review, sharing and archiving. Aspect consolidates these into one platform with drive mounting and an AI agent, and now markets itself as an AI studio for creative teams.
business_model: B2B SaaS for creative teams (pricing not found)
product_category: Media asset management and AI creative studio

founders.name: Gurish Sharma
prior_employers: A post-production company (name not given on YC page); led go-to-market and sales
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a founding member of the prior company.

founders.name: Edison Chiu
prior_employers: Same post-production company (scaled infrastructure and AI, 50TB+ a day)

founders.name: Bright Xu
prior_employers: Same post-production company (founding engineer, desktop and web clients)

technical_complexity.rationale: Streaming media files to desktop editors like a mounted drive with sync across Premiere, Resolve and Final Cut is hard systems work, plus indexing large footage.

defensibility.rationale: Storing a team's media and review history creates some lock-in, but the YC page itself positions against Dropbox, Frame.io and LucidLink.

market_need_then: The founders say they spent over 10,000 hours with in-house content teams at their previous company and saw teams stitching together five tools.

branding.domain_note: Uses aspect.inc; legal entity is Aspect Ratio, Inc. per the site footer. Purchase history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches for the name return many unrelated Aspect companies (Aspect Software, Aspect Build) and no brand coverage of this company.

outcome_analysis: Aspect is an active three person New York company from Fall 2025. Its founders came from a post-production company and know the media workflow problem. The site has expanded from storage and review into an AI generation studio with named customers. No verified funding or exit exists. Name collisions with other Aspect companies make public coverage thin.
notes: Unverified: 500K pre-seed in October 2025 from VCBacked only. No competitor sources dated near the batch were found, since searches returned contact-center software named Aspect; YC page names Dropbox, Frame.io and LucidLink as tools replaced. Prior employer is described but not named on the YC page. The site's AI studio positioning is a product expansion, not a dated pivot. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (VCBacked, 500K pre-seed, October 2025). Another directory dates a 500K YC seed 2025-09-29 and Dealroom shows 125K; no press release found. Aspect Build (3.85M) is a different company.
